urgencyScale.hint: One scale for requests and work orders. The five levels are fixed by Maintafox (they drive the request SLA, the backlog order and the indicators): you adjust their labels and target times. "Starter values" are proposed by the product and are to be confirmed by the plant.

urgencyScale.sourceStarterHint: Target times proposed by Maintafox, to confirm or adjust for the plant.
urgencyScale.sourceSlaRuleHint: Target times taken from the former "all origins" SLA rule of this level.
